final: WITH item_stats AS (SELECT order_item_id, COUNT(*) as line_item_count, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 THEN CAST(product_price AS FLOAT) / CAST(derived_total_cost AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) as avg_of_line_item_counts FROM item_stats
